### 4.1.3:

- As you can see, I'm changing the style of these releases.
- Also listing 3.0 -> 4.0 Changes.

1. Fully dropping music support as it is placed into another component, `[musicbot](https://github.com/tcfplayz/musicbot)`
2. Changed treasure rates to be much higher.
3. Changed enchantments:
- Sharpness -> Level 7
- Efficiency -> Level 10
- Fortune -> Level 6
4. Changed creeper difficulty (30% rate of it spawning in charged form)
5. Changed entity difficulty (On damaged, have a 15% rate of the mob having 1.25x the health it had)
6. Dropping 1.20.2 support.
